limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return. Example: 25

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Example: "eyJhZnRlciI6..."

actions.description: (Re-)send an invitation email to one or more pending users.

actions.description: Ingest raw log lines.

message.description: The message reserved attribute of your log.

ddsource.description: The integration name associated with your log.

hostname.description: The name of the originating host of the log.

service.description: The name of the application or service generating the log events.

logs.description: Array of log entries to send.

actions.description: Ingest custom metric data points
actions.name: submit-metrics

tags.description: Tags to associate with the metric. Example: ["env:prod"]

series.description: Array of metric series to submit

actions.description: Unmute a previously muted monitor.
actions.name: unmute-monitor

monitor_id.description: The ID of the monitor to unmute. Example: 310792870

actions.description: Rename an API key.
actions.name: update-api-key

name.description: The new name for the API key. Example: "Updated API Key Name"

actions.description: Update the profile of the user this connection authenticates as (name/title).
actions.name: update-current-user

actions.description: Update a dashboard's title, layout, or widgets.
actions.name: update-dashboard

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to update. Example: "abc-def-123"

title.description: The new title for the dashboard.

layout_type.description: The layout type of the dashboard. Example: "ordered" or "free".

widgets.description: The list of widgets to display on the dashboard.

template_variables.description: The list of template variables for the dashboard.

notify_list.description: The list of handles of users to notify when changes are made to this dashboard.

restricted_roles.description: A list of role UUIDs that have access to the dashboard.

actions.description: Update a monitor's name, query, message, or options.
actions.name: update-monitor

monitor_id.description: The ID of the monitor to update. Example: 12345

name.description: The new name for the monitor.

query.description: The new query for the monitor.

message.description: The new message for the monitor.

options.description: The new options for the monitor.

actions.name: update-organization

public_id.description: The public_id of the organization you are operating within. Example: "abc123"

name.description: The name of the organization, limited to 32 characters.

billing.description: Billing configuration. Deprecated but retained for compatibility.

type.description: The type of billing. Only `parent_billing` is supported.

subscription.description: Subscription configuration. Deprecated but retained for compatibility.

type.description: The subscription type. Types available are `trial`, `free`, and `pro`.

actions.description: Set or replace the restriction policy (access bindings) for a resource.
actions.name: update-restriction-policy

resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource to restrict. Example: "abc-def-ghi"

relation.description: Relationship between the principal and the resource. Example: "editor"

principals.description: List of principals in the form role:{roleId}, user:{userId}, or org:{orgId}. Example: ["role:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]

bindings.description: At least one binding is required. An empty array is rejected by the API.

relation.description: Relationship between the principal and the resource. Example: "editor"

principals.description: List of principals in the form role:{roleId}, user:{userId}, or org:{orgId}. Example: ["role:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]

name.description: New name for the test.

message.description: New notification message for the test.

status.description: Whether to start or pause the test.

tags.description: New array of tags attached to the test.

locations.description: New array of locations used to run the test.

config.description: New configuration object for the test.

options.description: New options object for the test.

actions.description: Update a team's name, handle, or description.

name.description: The new name for the team.

handle.description: The new handle for the team.

description.description: The new description for the team.
